text: {"lessons":["My account fell from NT$104,474 to NT$91,915, a substantial decline; I should review my risk and diversification rather than assume the portfolio will recover.","The losses have been uncomfortable, but they do not predict future prices; I should avoid panic-selling or trying to time the market based on recent movements.","I made no trades, so this record cannot show whether trading would have helped; I should make any future changes deliberately and in line with a clear plan."]}
